message.content:
This editorial illustration shows several human figures in a blue-walled room. Centrally, a large man with dark hair, a dark jacket, and a smile gazes toward the left. He holds a smaller man aloft with both hands. This smaller figure, wearing a red-and-black checkered shirt and glasses, has his arms raised. On the bottom right, a person in a white uniform and orange hard hat looks toward the center, held between a thumb and finger from an off-screen hand.

Yellow text at the bottom reads "THOHIR STORY." Below it, smaller yellow text states, "ERICK THOHIR MEROMBAK PEJABAT ESELON I KEMENTERIAN BUMN DAN PETINGGI KUNCI PERUSAHAAN PELAT MERAH. ADA TITIPAN ISTANA." At the top, white text says "MANUVER TITO MEROMBAK PILKADA" and "YANG TERSERET SUAP WALI KOTA MEDAN." The large white letters "TEMPO" appear behind the central figures. A barcode and "25 NOVEMBER-1 DESEMBER 2019" are visible in the lower right corner. The illustration uses a saturated color palette and a smooth, painted texture.
